Needs changes before merge.

The checkbox uses its caption as its accessible name. The new test checks the name, role, enabled state, and keyboard activation. The caption-click test still checks the command path. These two tests pass.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `768834bc7b08819d488fbac7d897d9bdc45cce47`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Pass |
| UI library | 965 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored |
| New checkbox test, run separately | 1 passed |
| Caption-click test, run separately | 1 passed |
| `egui_app` integration suite | 3 passed, 1 failed |
| `feedback` integration suite | 7 passed |
| `fixtures` integration suite | 7 passed |
| `models` integration suite | 4 passed |
| `operations` integration suite | 31 passed |
| `shell` integration suite | 20 passed, 1 failed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |

All three failures report that this machine has no graphics adapter. They affect `headless_run_succeeds`, `egui_headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`, and `headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero`.

```text
No suitable graphics adapter found
```

These failures limit the local graphics checks. They are not code findings. The first build attempt stopped without compiler artifacts. The next attempt used no sccache and passed. The gate dry run selected unrelated main changes from the trial merge, so this review selected the UI crate directly.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs:101` / PR body: Add before and after screenshots for this UI change. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit images to this PR branch.

Notes:

- This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No safety-tier mutation runs are required. This review ran no mutations and changed no code.
- No NC, CL, or snapshot goldens moved.
- The PR states that a pointer click on the right-column square was not verified. This review confirms keyboard activation and the caption-click command path only.
- No GitHub runner was used. The PR remains a draft until the requested evidence is present.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Added the requested before and after screenshots to the PR body. Both images are stored only on the fork’s images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `04820ef74b4081ff69246f6af5c2cb3193746dd2`.

The images show the same Threading Passes fixture before and after the helper fix. They are pixel-identical because the change affects accessibility. GPU capture found no adapter, so the body identifies these as CPU renders of the actual egui output.

The existing `thread_passes_repeat_each_depth_checkbox_has_label_role_and_enabled_state` pin failed with the upstream helper restored and passed with the fix restored.

Current head: `e04c3c19ab1f3f94c8ec8893b31374e0f00a36ae` (unchanged; this finding required evidence only). Plain `git push` reported everything up to date. No evidence files were committed to the PR branch.

Quick gate: red only because `headless_run_succeeds` cannot find a graphics adapter. The other 965 UI tests and all six selected integration suites passed. Clippy passed.

Please re-review the screenshot evidence on this head.

Addressed: The requested before and after screenshots are linked in the PR body. I verified both PNGs at images-only commit `04820ef74b4081ff69246f6af5c2cb3193746dd2`. They remain only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. No images or review evidence were committed to this PR branch.

Merged upstream/main to resolve the test-module registration conflict. Kept both `thread_repeat` and `break_through`. No other review fixes were requested.

The pin `thread_passes_repeat_each_depth_checkbox_has_label_role_and_enabled_state` failed with upstream/main's form helper restored and passed with the PR helper restored. Clippy on camcraft-ui passed.

Quick gate is red: 984 UI tests passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored. All six selected integration suites passed (30 tests). The failure is `rest_group_warns_and_refuses_incompatible_strategy_and_predrilled_on_apply` at `rest_pocket_tests.rs:280`: `Zigzag draft refusal`. It also fails with upstream/main's form helper restored. I left this unrelated behavior unchanged.

New head: `9b911826546ceb39cdf663a715db30f4a53780b7`.

Please re-review the screenshot evidence and conflict resolution. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b911826546ceb39cdf663a715db30f4a53780b7 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The checkbox uses its visible caption as its accessible name. The new test checks the name, role, enabled state, and keyboard activation. The existing caption-click test still checks the command path.

The earlier screenshot request is met. Both links load and show the Threading Passes controls. The body explains the CPU capture method and the unchanged pixels. The images are on the fork's images-only branch. This PR adds no images or review evidence.

The merge resolution keeps both `thread_repeat` and `break_through`. A local trial merge with upstream/main `3f41b8da6b65b8154132878e459d4430e3fb2063` has no conflicts.

Local checks:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Pass |
| UI library, serial, from `crates/ui` | 1001 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| New checkbox test, separate run | 1 passed |
| Caption-click command test, separate run | 1 passed |
| `egui_app` integration suite | 4 passed |
| `feedback` integration suite | 7 passed |
| `fixtures` integration suite | 7 passed |
| `models` integration suite | 4 passed |
| `operations` integration suite | 31 passed |
| `shell` integration suite | 21 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |

Test setup and limits:

- The gate dry run selected unrelated upstream changes from the trial merge. This review selected the UI crate directly.
- Cargo 1.100 places these test executables under `target/debug/build/.../out`. Upstream's asset resolver does not recognize this development layout. The first library run had 949 passes and 52 failures. Most failures reported missing post or machine assets.
- This review linked the trial tree's assets beside the test executables, inside the disposable `target/` directory. This uses the supported packaged layout. No source files changed.
- With those assets, the concurrent library run had 1000 passes, one failure, and six ignored tests. The failure was `each_setup_picks_its_own_machine_and_post_and_posts_one_file_per_mount`:

```text
Harness::run exceeded max_steps (4).
```

That test passes alone. The complete library passes with `--test-threads=1`. Its source and pointer helper are unchanged from upstream. The concurrent repaint timeout remains a test limitation.

Requested before merge: none.

This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No safety-tier mutation runs are required. This review ran no mutations. No NC, CL, or snapshot goldens moved. A native screen-reader check and a pointer click on the right-column square were not exercised. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
